title: Unit – 1 : Session – 11 : SLO – 2  |  EX-NOR gate
sections: 2. Output Condition — a) 1 when inputs are equal
5. Practical Application — e) Digital comparators and equality checking
Logic function: EX-NOR is the complement of EX-OR — output 1 when both inputs are EQUAL. Boolean expression: Y = (A⊕B)̅ = AB + A̅B̅.
Symbol: EX-OR symbol with an inversion bubble at the output.

Practical application: digital comparators — one EX-NOR per bit; all bits equal → all outputs 1 → AND them to detect equality of two numbers. Verifying all four input combinations experimentally reproduces the truth table.
